title: maDMP project config
description: One self-contained project config (configs/projects/<id>.yaml, the filename must be the declared id). Strict: every field required, none extra. Fields are grouped as the config file reads them: the project's own facts, then the rules it is built from, then what the generated DSW packages carry.

id.description: The project's one machine name, declared once: the filename this config sits at, and what everything generated for the project is named after. The pattern is DSW's own for a kmId, lowercase, digits and dashes, the middle third of `organizationId:id:version`.

name.description: What a reader sees, and only that. Free-form, it is never derived from `id`.

version.description: The project's version, bumped to publish a change. Semver X.Y.Z, the form DSW requires for the last third of the package identifier `organizationId:id:version`.

rules.description: Pinned rules versions, base first: [{standard: version}, ...] -> rules/standards/<standard>/<version>.json. One key per entry, both halves as the rules file declares them, the standard in snake_case and the version as a non-empty string (unquoted 1.0 would be a YAML float, not a version).

organizationId.description: The DSW organization the generated packages belong to. Lowercase, digits and dots, DSW's own character set for the first third of `organizationId:id:version`.
